description.p: AppNest is a high-performance Linux desktop application for managing, organizing, integrating, and launching AppImages.

Key features include an adaptive runtime execution engine (direct execution, extract-and-run without FUSE, and running the extracted AppRun), discovery of unmanaged AppImages, update checks using the update information embedded in AppImages, drag-and-drop file import, SHA-256 checksum verification, a full command-line interface, and GNOME Libadwaita desktop integration.
Update checks and downloads using the zsync update information embedded in AppImages, with checksum verification of every download.

A full command-line interface (list, info, import, launch, run, remove, scan, check-update, update, replace). Application menu entries and desktop shortcuts are now independent, and menu entries launch through AppNest so every entry point shares failure detection and runtime fallbacks. AppImages found in configurable scan folders are offered for import, and an application can be replaced with a newer AppImage file.

Security and reliability release. AppImages are fully validated before use, extraction is isolated and checked, desktop entries are escaped and namespaced, and the application database is transactional and recovers from corruption.

Launching now reports startup failures and only falls back to another method when the AppImage runtime itself fails. Launching, scanning and icon extraction no longer block the window. AppNest no longer changes default file associations or disables application sandboxes automatically.
File manager integration, desktop shortcuts creation, dynamic app process monitoring and termination, layout improvements, and performance optimizations.
Initial release of AppNest with adaptive runtime, drag-and-drop, and Libadwaita UI.
